{{Youmay|the phrase|[[Pateesa|the rancor]]}}
'''Pateesa''' was a term of endearment meaning "friend, sweetie, darling,"<ref name="Legacy glossary 1">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 1]]'' alien language glossary</ref> uttered occasionally by [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jariah Syn]]. It was used in regards to [[K'Kruhk]], probably sarcastically as though it were an insult. When used by Cade toward [[Deliah Blue]] it meant "sweetie" or "darling," and between Cade and Syn it meant "friend" or "buddy."
